subject: Scheduling: Security roundtable + CAIQ Q&A / artifact list
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Security <security@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: quick scheduling + CAIQ and logs request

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the fast reply to our intake form. Crestline is kicking off a SIG/CAIQ review as part of our vendor approval; our security team (cc'd) has a few clarifying questions and we'd like to set a short 30–45 minute session this week to walk through your CAIQ answers and get an exemplar set of access logs.

High level asks:
- Live call to run through CAIQ items we flagged (~30–45 minutes)
- Sample access logs covering the last 7 days (anonymized) — preferably a single PDF or CSV export
- Point of contact for audit/forensics questions

Are you available for a quick sync Thu 9/23 or Fri 9/24 morning PT? If neither works, please propose alternate times.

Attaching our vendor checklist (PDF) so you can see what triggered the intake.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Sr. InfoSec Manager — Crestline Health
Samantha.Lee@crestlinehealth.com
Attachment: crestline-vendor-checklist-2026.pdf (PDF)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: quick scheduling + CAIQ and logs request

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for sending the checklist. Happy to run a focused walkthrough.

Proposed times (all PT):
- Thu 9/23 10:00–10:45
- Fri 9/24 09:00–09:45

What we'll bring to the call:
- CAIQ answers (we'll share a completed spreadsheet ahead of time)
- A sanitized access logs sample (PDF) and a short notes doc describing redaction approach
- Our compliance lead (Marissa) and platform engineer (Olga) for deeper questions on logs and retention

Action items for us:
- I will upload the CAIQ answers and a sanitized logs sample to a shared Drive link prior to the call.
- Marissa will confirm SLA/retention questions on the call.
- Olga will be available for any technical deep-dive on log formats and KV cache retention artifacts.

Let me know which of the two times works, or propose alternatives; if you want a 45-minute slot we can extend.

Attachments: CAIQ-answers-template-v1.xlsx (Spreadsheet) — I'll populate and send by EOD Wed.

—
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@crestlinehealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: quick scheduling + CAIQ and logs request

Hi Samantha — adding a few concrete notes so the call is productive.

On artifacts and owners:
- CAIQ answers: Logan (SE) will provide a completed spreadsheet ahead of the call.
- Access logs sample: Olga (Platform) will export and sanitize a 7‑day sample (we redact IPs/user identifiers; will include event types and timestamps).
- Retention + SLAs: I will cover our default retention windows, options for extended retention on Dedicated/Private deployments, and how audit exports are produced.

Please confirm the environment you want logs from (hosted API vs Dedicated instance). If you need Dedicated environment logs we may need a short provisioning window to gather representative data.

Suggested agenda (30–45 min):
1) 5 min intro & scope confirmation
2) 15–20 min CAIQ Q&A on flagged items
3) 10–15 min logs sample review + retention discussion
4) 5 min next steps/action owners + artifacts handoff

If you want more time we'll make it 45 min.

Thanks — will upload artifacts to the Drive link Logan creates.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, IT Security <security@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: quick scheduling + CAIQ and logs request

Thanks everyone — the Fri slot works best for our team. Confirming: Fri 9/24 09:00 PT (30–45 min). Please send the Drive link and CAIQ spreadsheet at least 24 hours before the call.

A couple of quick clarifications from IT Security:
- Please include a short note describing how PII is identified and redacted in the sample logs.
- Can you also indicate whether your hosted API supports S3-style object access logs or if exports are only available via admin console?

We have uploaded a short vendor intake form to a shared location (see attachment); not required for the call but helpful.

Looking forward — Samantha

Samantha Lee
Sr. InfoSec Manager — Crestline Health
Attachment: crestline-vendor-checklist-2026.pdf (PDF)
